# Drawdown-recovery TQQQ v2 — development report

**Verdict: PASS the development bar, with a caveat that matters.**  On
2016-01-04 .. 2023-12-29 the strategy makes **57.63% CAGR at 43.39% max
drawdown, 1.25 Sharpe, 78.8% average exposure, 27 fills** (1 bp, 1-minute
marks, next-open fills, 2% band).  TQQQ buy-and-hold on the same bars makes
36.15% / 82.29% / 0.80.  The strategy is a **crash circuit breaker**, not a
broad recovery alpha: removing 2022 leaves 75.27% CAGR versus TQQQ's 77.75%,
but with 41.11% drawdown versus 69.89%.  The headline CAGR edge is the 2022
avoidance; the risk reduction is present in every subperiod.

No 2024+ bar entered the panel, any signal or any statistic: `bt.panel`
slices the 1-minute archive at 2023-12-29.  All numbers below are
development-window numbers.

---

## 1. Rules

One decision per session at the QQQ close; TQQQ is bought or sold at the next
session's open by `research/bt.py` (2% band, 1 bp headline; 5 and 10 bp
reported).  Idle weight is cash at 0%.  Long-only, weight in {0, 1}.

```
dd20 = q / max(q[-19..0]) - 1
dd60 = q / max(q[-59..0]) - 1
vr   = sigma10(lagged) / sigma60(lagged), annualised
hi10 = max(q[-10..-1])
```

Default state **LONG**.  A position is opened at the first session and after
every recovery.

**LONG -> CASH.**
- Normal position: `dd20 <= -8%` or `dd60 <= -12%`.
- A position entered from a deep cash episode: `dd20 <= -8%` or an 8%
  drawdown from its own post-entry high.  The stale 60-day drawdown is
  ignored until `dd60 > -12%`, otherwise the position would be stopped out
  the day after entry by a drawdown that predates it.
- On exit, `deep = (dd60 <= -12%)`.

**CASH -> LONG.**  `deep` is sticky while in cash.
- deep: re-enter when `vr < 0.60` (volatility contraction).  The 10-day high
  is **not** enough; a 10-day high in a bear market is a bear rally.
- shallow: re-enter when `vr < 0.60` **or** `q > hi10`.

Indicator warmup is QQQ daily closes from 2015-01-02..2015-12-31 only.  The
1-minute panel is physically sliced at 2023-12-29.

The "exit on a 10-session low" branch from the mandate was implemented and
tested.  It is a negative ablation (§6): it exits every ordinary pullback,
raises fills from 27 to 127 and cuts CAGR to 30.37%.

## 2. Headline development result

| Cost | CAGR | Max DD | Sharpe | Sortino | Vol | Exposure | Fills | End equity |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 bp | **57.63%** | **43.39%** | **1.25** | 1.78 | 44.19% | 78.8% | 27 | $3,783,755 |
| 5 bp | 57.41% | 43.48% | 1.25 | 1.77 | 44.19% | 78.8% | 27 | $3,743,111 |
| 10 bp | 57.15% | 43.60% | 1.25 | 1.77 | 44.18% | 78.8% | 27 | $3,692,920 |
| TQQQ B&H | 36.15% | 82.29% | 0.80 | 1.12 | 66.55% | 100% | 1 | $1,175,165 |
| Brief bar | 36.72% | 82.29% | 0.82 | — | — | — | — | — |

- Daily-return correlation to TQQQ: **0.667**.
- Worst drawdown: **2018-01-29 -> 2018-04-25, -43.39%**.  TQQQ's drawdown in
  that same window was -33.27%: the worst episode is a whipsaw, not a bear
  market, and the strategy amplified it.
- CAGR is 20.9 pp above the bar and DD is 38.9 pp below the DD bar; the
  result is not a marginal pass.
- The 5 bp and 10 bp results differ by 0.2/0.5 pp: 27 fills over 8 years make
  the strategy almost cost-insensitive.
- Cross-check on daily open-to-open bars: 58.01% CAGR / 40.52% DD, within
  0.4 pp of CAGR and 2.9 pp of DD of the 1-minute result.  The higher 1-minute
  DD is the intraday mark, as expected.

## 3. Yearly returns

| Year | Strategy | TQQQ | Exposure |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2016 | +16.1% | +19.9% | 81.0% |
| 2017 | +114.5% | +114.5% | 100.0% |
| 2018 | **-3.9%** | **-20.8%** | 69.5% |
| 2019 | +75.1% | +148.2% | 92.4% |
| 2020 | **+129.8%** | **+104.1%** | 69.1% |
| 2021 | +68.6% | +81.1% | 96.4% |
| 2022 | **-26.0%** | **-79.4%** | 23.9% |
| 2023 | +189.5% | +192.0% | 98.0% |

The strategy wins 2017 (tie), 2018, 2020 and 2022, ties 2023, and lags 2016,
2019 and 2021.  2019 is the worst relative year: the December-2018 deep cash
episode ended only on 2019-01-22, so the strategy missed the first leg of the
2019 rebound, and a 5-day May cash episode missed another +15.1% TQQQ pop.
The strategy still made +75% that year.

## 4. Pre-registered grid and plateau

Eight cells, fixed before the reported run.  Centre is cell 2.

| # | dd20 | dd60 | vol | CAGR | Max DD | Sharpe | Exposure | Fills |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 7% | 11% | 0.60 | 38.83% | 42.97% | 1.01 | 72.4% | 37 |
| **2** | **8%** | **12%** | **0.60** | **57.63%** | **43.39%** | **1.25** | **78.8%** | **27** |
| 3 | 9% | 13% | 0.60 | 40.99% | 57.00% | 0.97 | 81.7% | 31 |
| 4 | 10% | 15% | 0.60 | 32.00% | 58.93% | 0.82 | 83.1% | 31 |
| 5 | 8% | 12% | 0.55 | 58.73% | 43.39% | 1.27 | 78.7% | 25 |
| 6 | 8% | 12% | 0.65 | 57.48% | 43.39% | 1.25 | 78.9% | 31 |
| 7 | 7% | 11% | 0.65 | 45.73% | 42.71% | 1.10 | 76.1% | 41 |
| 8 | 9% | 13% | 0.55 | 41.98% | 57.00% | 0.99 | 81.7% | 29 |

**Read of the plateau.**  The vol-ratio direction is flat: 0.55, 0.60 and
0.65 all give 57-59% CAGR at the same 43.39% DD.  The exit-threshold
direction is *not* flat: 7/11, 8/12 and 9/13 all clear the CAGR bar
(38.8%, 57.6%, 41.0%) and the 60% DD target, but 10/15 fails the CAGR bar
(32.0%).  The pass region is a band, not a single cell, but the centre is a
clear local peak: moving one step in either direction costs 17-19 pp of
CAGR.  That is the main overfitting risk in this report.

## 5. Neighbours (not used to choose the centre)

| Variant | CAGR | Max DD | Sharpe | Exposure | Comment |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| centre | 57.63% | 43.39% | 1.25 | 78.8% | — |
| hi_window 5 | 55.59% | 48.39% | 1.21 | 79.8% | shorter confirmation, more whipsaw |
| hi_window 20 | 48.27% | 44.18% | 1.13 | 76.1% | slower recovery, lower CAGR |
| trail 6% | 57.63% | 43.39% | 1.25 | 78.8% | identical; trail never binds in dev |
| trail 10% | 57.63% | 43.39% | 1.25 | 78.8% | identical |
| shallow vol-only | 46.11% | 40.80% | 1.14 | 71.0% | 10-day high adds 11.5 pp |
| shallow hi-only | 57.63% | 43.39% | 1.25 | 78.8% | identical: shallow vol branch never fires |
| deep vol-or-hi | 38.23% | 65.45% | 0.91 | 85.2% | **fails the 60% DD target** |
| start in cash | 60.14% | 43.39% | 1.29 | 78.6% | result does not rely on day-1 exposure |

The deep branch is the load-bearing part.  Replacing "deep = volatility
contraction only" with "volatility contraction or 10-day high" re-enters
2022 bear rallies, raises exposure to 85.2% and DD to 65.45%, and cuts CAGR
to 38.23%.  The shallow branch is the other load-bearing part: removing the
10-day high (shallow vol-only) costs 11.5 pp of CAGR while lowering DD only
2.6 pp.

The trail parameter is inert in dev because the 20-day-high exit always fires
first after a recovery entry.  It is kept as a backstop, not as a tuned
parameter.

## 6. Ablations

| Variant | CAGR | Max DD | Sharpe | Exposure | Fills |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| centre | 57.63% | 43.39% | 1.25 | 78.8% | 27 |
| + 10-day-low exit | 30.37% | 39.70% | 0.93 | 58.5% | 127 |
| trailing-only exit | 56.20% | 46.59% | 1.20 | 80.2% | 27 |
| no deep/slow branch | 38.23% | 65.45% | 0.91 | 85.2% | 47 |

The 10-day-low exit is the clearest negative result in the mandate: it turns
a 27-fill, 57.6% CAGR strategy into a 127-fill, 30.4% CAGR strategy.  A
10-day low is an ordinary pullback in a bull trend, not a regime break.

Trailing-only exits (8% from the post-entry high, no rolling 20/60-day
trigger) are close -- 56.20% CAGR -- but the DD rises to 46.59%, so the
rolling-drawdown formulation is retained.

## 7. Placebo

Both placebos re-use the exact weight-mapping and simulator.  80 draws each.

| Placebo | Mean CAGR | 95th pct | p(>= 57.63%) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Block permutation of the daily target (20-session blocks) | 26.31% | 45.20% | 0.000 |
| Random circuit breaker, same cash-run lengths, random dates | 28.79% | 49.29% | 0.0125 |

The real result is above the 95th percentile of both nulls.  A random
circuit breaker with the same average cash exposure (about 21%) makes only
28.8% CAGR, so the result is not merely "be out of the market 21% of the
time"; the *timing* of the drawdown exits carries the edge.  The constant-
exposure control makes 32.46% CAGR with a 72.48% DD, which says the same
thing more simply.

## 8. Cut tests and subperiods

| Cut | Strategy CAGR | Strategy DD | TQQQ CAGR | TQQQ DD |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| ex-2018 | 68.84% | 38.54% | 46.60% | 81.68% |
| ex-2020 | 48.85% | 41.11% | 27.84% | 81.68% |
| ex-2022 | **75.27%** | **41.11%** | **77.75%** | **69.89%** |
| ex-2023 | 44.46% | 41.11% | 21.49% | 81.68% |

| Subperiod | Strategy CAGR | Strategy DD | TQQQ CAGR | TQQQ DD |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2016-2019 | 44.38% | 43.39% | 48.33% | 58.62% |
| 2020-2021 | 98.07% | 40.76% | 95.24% | 72.74% |
| 2022-2023 | 46.73% | 40.63% | -21.15% | 81.10% |

The ex-2022 cut is the honest one: without 2022 the strategy **slightly
lags** TQQQ's CAGR (75.27% vs 77.75%) but with 28.8 pp less drawdown.  So
the headline CAGR pass is concentrated in 2022, while the DD improvement is
present in every cut.  The subperiod table tells the same story: 2016-2019
lags TQQQ's CAGR by 4 pp (44.38% vs 48.33%) but with 15 pp less drawdown;
2020-2021 and 2022-2023 beat on both.  The strategy is a crash-avoidance
overlay, not a bull-market alpha source.

## 9. Attribution: 13 cash episodes

`cash` means the fill-to-fill period from the exit signal to the re-entry
signal.  TQQQ return is the return that would have been earned if the
strategy had stayed long.

| Exit signal | Re-entry signal | Days | QQQ | TQQQ (avoided) |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|

| 2022-08-29 | 2022-09-27 | 21 | -7.9% | **-28.5%** |
| 2022-09-29 | 2022-11-25 | 41 | +3.9% | +5.8% |
| 2022-12-20 | 2023-01-06 | 12 | +0.4% | -2.7% |

Net log TQQQ during cash: **-1.194** (the strategy avoided a 3.3x move, in
log terms).  Five of thirteen cash episodes avoided a loss; eight missed a
rally.  The net is still positive because the avoided losses are much larger
than the missed rallies.  The biggest single cost is 2018-02-08..02-22,
where the strategy exited at the bottom of the February 2018 crash and
missed a +27.1% TQQQ rebound; that is the origin of the 43% 2018 drawdown.
The 2020-10-30..11-03 exit also missed a +25.0% three-day election rally, and
2019-05-31..06-06 missed +15.1%.

The 14 round trips (dates are decision dates; returns are next-open to
next-open):

Five long winners (+180%, +56%, +104%, +49%, +190%) carry the result; the
rest are small losses.  This is a "let the winner run, cut the crash" profile,
not a high-frequency recovery trader.

## 10. Honest verdict and holdout risk

**What is real.**  The drawdown trigger and the two-speed re-entry are
causal, the 5/10 bp sensitivity is negligible, the placebo timing test is
significant, the ex-2018/ex-2020/ex-2023 cuts all beat TQQQ, and the
truncation test at 2022-01-03 reproduces the prior weights exactly.  The
result is not a one-cell artefact: 7/11 and 9/13 clear the CAGR bar and the
60% DD target, and the vol ratio is flat from 0.55 to 0.65.

**What is fragile.**
1. **Only three major crash episodes.**  2018Q4, 2020Q1 and 2022 drive the
   edge (7 of the 14 round trips are classified deep, but the other deep
   entries are small).  The pass is a statement about three macro events, not
   a large sample.  The bootstrap/placebo cannot create more independent
   crashes.
2. **The CAGR edge is 2022.**  Ex-2022 the strategy is 2.5 pp *behind*
   TQQQ's CAGR, though with half the drawdown.  If the holdout has no
   2022-like bear, the headline CAGR will not repeat; the DD reduction is
   the part that should.
3. **The worst DD is a whipsaw.**  2018-01-29 -> 2018-04-25 lost 43.39%,
   versus TQQQ's 33.27% in the same window.  A repeat in the holdout would
   be uncomfortable even though the full-period DD bar is met.
4. **Bull-market whipsaw.**  2019 lagged TQQQ by 73 pp (75.1% vs 148.2%)
   because the deep re-entry waited until 2019-01-22 and the May 2019
   shallow exit missed a fast +15.1% TQQQ pop.  A steady 2024-2026 bull with
   8-10% pullbacks would produce the same pattern.
5. **The centre is a local peak.**  7/11 and 9/13 are 17-19 pp lower.  The
   neighbours pass, but the grid is not a broad plateau in the exit
   dimension.

**Holdout arithmetic.**  The dev multiple is 37.84x ($100k -> $3.78M) versus
TQQQ's 11.75x.  For the full 2016-2026 CAGR to beat 37.54%, the holdout
multiple only has to exceed about 0.83x -- the strategy can lose roughly 17%
over 2024-2026 and still clear the full-period bar.  That is a large cushion
and the main reason this candidate has a real chance.  The failure mode is a
repeat of 2019: a strong, shallow-pullback bull in which the circuit breaker
exits and re-enters higher several times, giving back the cushion.  The
2024-08 and 2025-04 drawdown-recovery pattern is, mechanically, the kind of
event this strategy is designed for; a steady melt-up is not.

**Recommendation to the lead.**  Run the one-shot holdout.  If it passes,
the honest description is "a fast drawdown circuit breaker with a two-speed
recovery re-entry that roughly matches TQQQ's CAGR ex-2022 with about half
the drawdown, and wins the full sample through 2022 avoidance" -- not "a
new source of broad recovery alpha".
hypothesis_md:
# Drawdown-recovery TQQQ v2: a two-speed circuit breaker

**Status:** pre-registered before the reported run. Development window only.
**Author:** research subagent, 2026-11-27.
**Directory:** `research/new/drawdown-recovery-v2/`

---

## 0. Scope

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Development window | 2016-01-04 .. 2023-12-29 |
| Data | `data/intraday-hf/` adjusted 1-minute QQQ, TQQQ, BIL |
| Fills | next-bar open, `research/bt.py`, 2% band |
| Costs | 1 bp headline; 5 bp and 10 bp reported |
| Constraints | long-only, weights >= 0, row sum <= 1, idle cash at 0% |
| Holdout | never used; the panel, signals and statistics end 2023-12-29 |
| Bar | TQQQ dev 36.72% CAGR / 82.29% max DD / 0.82 Sharpe |

Indicator warmup uses QQQ **daily** closes from 2015-01-02 to 2015-12-31
only.  The 1-minute archive starts 2016-01-04, so no 2024+ bar enters the
panel or any signal.

## 1. Hypothesis

TQQQ's 82% dev drawdown is not a smooth decay: it is a handful of fast
drawdowns (2018Q4, 2020Q1, 2022) followed by violent recoveries.  A slow
moving-average gate (the old 165-day rule) reacts late and gives back much of
the recovery.  A **fast drawdown circuit breaker with a recovery re-entry**
should keep most of TQQQ's drift, step aside during the acute phase of a
crash, and re-enter when the panic has demonstrably ended.

The key design question is the re-entry speed.  A single "buy after a 10-day
high" rule re-enters every bear-market rally; a single "wait for volatility to
contract" rule misses the first leg of a V recovery (for example the
2022-12 -> 2023-04 +50% TQQQ move).  The drawdown **depth** tells the two
cases apart:

- a shallow pullback (down 8% from the 20-day high, but not 12% from the
  60-day high) is an ordinary bull-market correction; it recovers quickly, so
  a 10-day high is enough;
- a deep drawdown (12% or more from the 60-day high) is a bear/crash regime;
  a 10-day high is usually a bear rally, so wait for realized volatility to
  contract to 0.60x its 60-day level before buying.

This is a high-exposure recovery bet: the default position is 100% TQQQ, and
only the acute drawdown phase is spent in cash.

## 2. Exact rules (one decision per session, at the close)

Let `q` be the QQQ session close, `dd20 = q / max(q[-19..0]) - 1`,
`dd60 = q / max(q[-59..0]) - 1`, `hi10 = max(q[-10..-1])`.

`v10` and `v60` are the annualised standard deviations of QQQ daily log
returns over the last 10 and 60 **completed** sessions (lagged one session),
and `vr = v10 / v60`.  All indicators are trailing and causal.

State: `LONG` (default) or `CASH`; flags `deep` and `recovery`.

**LONG -> CASH (new drawdown).**
- Normal position: exit if `dd20 <= -8%` **or** `dd60 <= -12%`.
- Recovery position (entered from a deep cash episode): exit if
  `dd20 <= -8%` **or** `q / (highest close since entry) - 1 <= -8%`.
  The stale 60-day drawdown is ignored until `dd60 > -12%`; otherwise the
  position would be stopped out the day after entry for a drawdown that
  predates it.
- On exit set `deep = (dd60 <= -12%)`.

**CASH -> LONG (recovery).**  While in cash, `deep` is sticky: it becomes
true as soon as `dd60 <= -12%` at any close.
- if `deep`: re-enter when `vr < 0.60` (volatility contraction);
- if not `deep`: re-enter when `vr < 0.60` **or** `q > hi10`
  (10-session high).
- On entry set `peak = q`, `recovery = deep`, `deep = False`.

The 2% band and next-open fills are the harness defaults.  Idle weight is
cash at 0%.  The "10-session low" exit from the mandate was implemented and
tested; it is reported as a negative ablation (it exits every ordinary
pullback and cuts CAGR to about 31%).

## 3. Pre-registered grid (8 cells)

| # | dd20 | dd60 | vol ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 7% | 11% | 0.60 |
| 2 | **8%** | **12%** | **0.60** |
| 3 | 9% | 13% | 0.60 |
| 4 | 10% | 15% | 0.60 |
| 5 | 8% | 12% | 0.55 |
| 6 | 8% | 12% | 0.65 |
| 7 | 7% | 11% | 0.65 |
| 8 | 9% | 13% | 0.55 |

The centre (cell 2) is the headline.  A pass is only credible if the
neighbours are also above the bar or at least close, and if the mechanism
survives the ablations below.

## 4. Planned robustness (not used to choose the centre)

- Neighbours: confirmation window 5/20, trail 6/10%, deep rule vol-or-hi,
  shallow rule hi-only, TQQQ-based signal instead of QQQ, start-in-cash.
- Ablations: vol-only re-entry, hi-only re-entry, 10-day-low exit,
  trailing-only exit, no deep/slow branch.
- Placebo: block permutation of the daily target series (preserves the
  duration distribution) and a random circuit breaker with the same number
  of exits and the same cash-duration distribution.
- Cut tests: ex-2018, ex-2020, ex-2022, ex-2023; subperiods 2016-2019,
  2020-2021, 2022-2023.
- Causality: rebuild weights on data truncated at 2022-01-03 and compare
  with the full-sample weights on the overlap.

## 5. Falsification / honest risks

- **Small number of episodes.**  The dev window contains roughly 14 round
  trips and only three deep episodes (2018Q4, 2020Q1, 2022).  A pass is
  therefore a statement about a few macro events, not a large sample.
- **2022 dependence.**  A circuit breaker can beat TQQQ's CAGR mainly by
  avoiding 2022's -80%.  If the ex-2022 cut is below TQQQ, the headline is
  crash avoidance, not broad alpha.  This will be reported explicitly.
- **Bull-market whipsaw.**  In 2019 the 8% trigger exited just before a
  +25% TQQQ rally and re-entered late; the strategy lagged TQQQ badly that
  year.  A holdout with only shallow pullbacks could do the same.
- **No shorting, no leverage beyond 100% TQQQ, no BIL yield.**  Cash earns
  0%, which is conservative relative to a T-bill sleeve.

```
dd20 = q / max(q[-19..0]) - 1
dd60 = q / max(q[-59..0]) - 1
vr   = sigma10(lagged) / sigma60(lagged), annualised
hi10 = max(q[-10..-1])
```

Default state **LONG**.  A position is opened at the first session and after
every recovery.

**LONG -> CASH.**
- Normal position: `dd20 <= -8%` or `dd60 <= -12%`.
- A position entered from a deep cash episode: `dd20 <= -8%` or an 8%
  drawdown from its own post-entry high.  The stale 60-day drawdown is
  ignored until `dd60 > -12%`, otherwise the position would be stopped out
  the day after entry by a drawdown that predates it.
- On exit, `deep = (dd60 <= -12%)`.

**CASH -> LONG.**  `deep` is sticky while in cash.
- deep: re-enter when `vr < 0.60` (volatility contraction).  The 10-day high
  is **not** enough; a 10-day high in a bear market is a bear rally.
- shallow: re-enter when `vr < 0.60` **or** `q > hi10`.

Indicator warmup is QQQ daily closes from 2015-01-02..2015-12-31 only.  The
1-minute panel is physically sliced at 2023-12-29.

The "exit on a 10-session low" branch from the mandate was implemented and
tested.  It is a negative ablation (§6): it exits every ordinary pullback,
raises fills from 27 to 127 and cuts CAGR to 30.37%.

"""Drawdown-recovery TQQQ v2: two-speed circuit breaker.

Standalone strategy, development window only (2016-01-04 .. 2023-12-29).

Rules
-----
Signal: QQQ session close (15:59 print).  Position: TQQQ.  Idle: cash at 0%.
One decision per session at the close, filled at the next session's open by
the shared `research/bt.py` simulator (2% band, 1 bp headline).

    dd20 = q / max(q[-19..0]) - 1
    dd60 = q / max(q[-59..0]) - 1
    vr   = sigma10(lagged) / sigma60(lagged)       (annualised)

State machine, default LONG:
  LONG -> CASH when dd20 <= -8% or dd60 <= -12%  (a new drawdown).
  A position entered from a deep cash episode is instead stopped by
  dd20 <= -8% or an 8% drawdown from its own post-entry high, until the
  stale dd60 heals above -12%.
  CASH -> LONG when the cash episode was deep (dd60 reached -12%) and
  vr < 0.60 (volatility contraction), or when it was shallow and either
  vr < 0.60 or q > max(q[-10..-1]) (a 10-session high).

Indicator warmup uses QQQ daily closes from 2015-01-02..2015-12-31 only.
The 1-minute panel is physically sliced at 2023-12-29; no 2024+ bar is used.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "research"))
import bt  # noqa: E402

DEV_START = "2016-01-04"
DEV_END = "2023-12-29"
BARS_1M = 252 * 390
SYMBOLS = ("QQQ", "TQQQ", "BIL")
COL_Q, COL_T = 0, 1

# pre-registered centre
ARM_20 = 0.08
ARM_60 = 0.12
VOL_RATIO = 0.60
VOL_WIN = 10
VOL_LONG = 60
HI_N = 10
TRAIL = 0.08          # backstop for a recovery position; never binds in dev
DEEP_DD60 = 0.12
WARMUP_START = "2015-01-02"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# panel and signals
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def load_panel(start: str = DEV_START, end: str = DEV_END):
    return bt.panel(SYMBOLS, start, end, "1min", warmup_days=0)


def _pre_closes(first_session_date) -> np.ndarray:
    """QQQ total-return daily closes strictly before the intraday archive."""
    daily = pd.read_parquet(bt.DATA_DIR / "QQQ-1d-yahoo.parquet")
    daily["date"] = pd.to_datetime(daily["date"]).dt.date
    pre = daily[daily["date"] < first_session_date].sort_values("date")
    pre = pre[pre["date"] >= pd.Timestamp(WARMUP_START).date()]
    return pre["adjclose"].to_numpy(dtype=float)


def _rmax_excl(x: np.ndarray, n: int) -> np.ndarray:
    return pd.Series(x).rolling(n, min_periods=n).max().shift(1).to_numpy()


def _rmin_excl(x: np.ndarray, n: int) -> np.ndarray:
    return pd.Series(x).rolling(n, min_periods=n).min().shift(1).to_numpy()


def _rstd_lag(x: np.ndarray, n: int) -> np.ndarray:
    s = pd.Series(x).rolling(n, min_periods=n).std(ddof=0).to_numpy()
    out = np.full(len(x), np.nan)
    out[1:] = s[:-1]
    return out


def session_signals(ts, closes):
    """Causal daily arrays aligned to the 2012 dev sessions."""
    dates, first, last = bt.day_bounds(ts)
    nd = len(first)
    q = np.asarray(closes, dtype=float)[last, COL_Q]
    pre = _pre_closes(dates[first][0])
    npre = len(pre)
    qa = np.r_[pre, q]
    r = np.full(len(qa), np.nan)
    r[1:] = np.log(qa[1:] / qa[:-1])
    v10 = _rstd_lag(r, VOL_WIN)[npre:] * np.sqrt(252.0)
    v60 = _rstd_lag(r, VOL_LONG)[npre:] * np.sqrt(252.0)
    return {
        "dates": dates, "first": first, "last": last, "nd": nd,
        "q": q,
        "dd20": (qa / _rmax_excl(qa, 20) - 1.0)[npre:],
        "dd60": (qa / _rmax_excl(qa, 60) - 1.0)[npre:],
        "hi5": _rmax_excl(qa, 5)[npre:],
        "hi10": _rmax_excl(qa, 10)[npre:],
        "hi20": _rmax_excl(qa, 20)[npre:],
        "lo10": _rmin_excl(qa, 10)[npre:],
        "v10": v10, "v60": v60,
        "vr": v10 / np.maximum(v60, 1e-12),
        "npre": npre,
    }


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# state machine
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def state_machine(sig: dict, arm_20: float = ARM_20, arm_60: float = ARM_60,
                  vol_ratio: float = VOL_RATIO, hi_n: int = HI_N,
                  trail: float = TRAIL, deep_dd60: float = DEEP_DD60,
                  deep_rule: str = "vol_only",
                  shallow_rule: str = "hi_or_vol",
                  start_long: bool = True, use_lo_exit: bool = False,
                  trail_only: bool = False):
    """Return per-session target weights and the round-trip episode list."""
    q = sig["q"]
    dd20, dd60 = sig["dd20"], sig["dd60"]
    hi = sig[f"hi{hi_n}"]
    lo = sig["lo10"] if use_lo_exit else None
    vr = sig["vr"]
    n = len(q)
    t = np.zeros(n)
    w = 1.0 if start_long else 0.0
    peak = q[0] if start_long else np.nan
    deep = False
    recovery = False
    eps: list[dict] = []
    if start_long:
        eps.append({"entry_i": 0, "entry_why": "initial"})
    for i in range(n):
        if not (np.isfinite(dd20[i]) and np.isfinite(dd60[i])
                and np.isfinite(vr[i])):
            t[i] = w
            continue
        if w > 0:
            peak = max(peak, q[i])
            lo_trig = lo is not None and np.isfinite(lo[i]) and q[i] < lo[i]
            if trail_only:
                exit_trig = q[i] / peak - 1.0 <= -trail or lo_trig
            elif recovery:
                exit_trig = (q[i] / peak - 1.0 <= -trail
                             or dd20[i] <= -arm_20 or lo_trig)
                if dd60[i] > -arm_60:
                    recovery = False
            else:
                exit_trig = dd20[i] <= -arm_20 or dd60[i] <= -arm_60 or lo_trig
            if exit_trig:
                w = 0.0
                deep = dd60[i] <= -arm_60
                if eps and "exit_i" not in eps[-1]:
                    eps[-1].update({
                        "exit_i": i,
                        "exit_why": ("lo10" if lo_trig else
                                     ("dd" if not trail_only else "trail")),
                        "deep": bool(deep),
                        "qret": float(q[i] / q[eps[-1]["entry_i"]] - 1.0),
                        "days": int(i - eps[-1]["entry_i"]),
                    })
        else:
            if dd60[i] <= -arm_60:
                deep = True
            vol_ok = vr[i] < vol_ratio
            hi_ok = np.isfinite(hi[i]) and q[i] > hi[i]
            if deep:
                trig = vol_ok if deep_rule == "vol_only" else (vol_ok or hi_ok)
            else:
                if shallow_rule == "hi_only":
                    trig = hi_ok
                elif shallow_rule == "vol_only":
                    trig = vol_ok
                else:
                    trig = hi_ok or vol_ok
            if trig:
                w = 1.0
                peak = q[i]
                recovery = deep
                deep = False
                eps.append({
                    "entry_i": i,
                    "entry_why": ("deep_vol" if recovery and vol_ok else
                                  ("deep_hi" if recovery else
                                   ("shallow_hi" if hi_ok and not vol_ok else "shallow_vol"))),
                    "entry_dd20": float(dd20[i]),
                    "entry_dd60": float(dd60[i]),
                    "entry_vr": float(vr[i]),
                })
        t[i] = w
    if eps and "exit_i" not in eps[-1]:
        eps[-1].update({
            "exit_i": n - 1, "exit_why": "open", "deep": bool(deep),
            "qret": float(q[-1] / q[eps[-1]["entry_i"]] - 1.0),
            "days": int(n - 1 - eps[-1]["entry_i"]),
        })
    return t, eps


def weights_from_daily(sig: dict, t: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Map one target per session to per-bar weights.

    `weights[i]` is set at the close of bar i and filled at the open of bar
    i+1.  The last bar of session k carries the new target t[k]; the rest of
    session k carries the previous target t[k-1].
    """
    first, last, nd = sig["first"], sig["last"], sig["nd"]
    n = int(last[-1]) + 1
    w1 = np.zeros(n)
    prev = 0.0
    for k in range(nd):
        f, l = int(first[k]), int(last[k])
        w1[f:l] = prev
        w1[l] = t[k]
        prev = t[k]
    w1[-1] = w1[-2]
    return w1


def build_weights(ts, opens, closes, arm_20: float = ARM_20,
                  arm_60: float = ARM_60, vol_ratio: float = VOL_RATIO,
                  hi_n: int = HI_N, trail: float = TRAIL,
                  deep_rule: str = "vol_only",
                  shallow_rule: str = "hi_or_vol",
                  start_long: bool = True, use_lo_exit: bool = False,
                  trail_only: bool = False,
                  return_episodes: bool = False):
    sig = session_signals(ts, closes)
    t, eps = state_machine(sig, arm_20, arm_60, vol_ratio, hi_n, trail,
                           DEEP_DD60, deep_rule, shallow_rule, start_long,
                           use_lo_exit, trail_only)
    w1 = weights_from_daily(sig, t)
    w = np.zeros((len(ts), 3))
    w[:, COL_T] = w1[:len(ts)]
    assert (w >= 0).all() and (w.sum(axis=1) <= 1.0 + 1e-9).all()
    if return_episodes:
        return w, eps, sig, t
    return w


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# evaluation helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def pack(s: dict) -> dict:
    keys = ("cagr", "max_drawdown", "sharpe", "sortino", "volatility",
            "exposure", "turnover", "fills", "ending_equity", "years")
    return {k: (int(s[k]) if k == "fills" else float(s[k])) for k in keys}


def run_weights(ts, o, c, w, start=DEV_START, slip=1.0):
    r = bt.run(ts, o, c, w, start, band=0.02, slippage_bps=slip)
    return r, bt.stats(r, BARS_1M)


def daily_returns(res: dict) -> pd.Series:
    s = pd.Series(res["equity"], index=res["ts"])
    return s.groupby(res["ts"].date).last().pct_change().dropna()


def dd_window(ts, equity):
    peak = np.maximum.accumulate(equity)
    dd = equity / peak - 1.0
    j = int(np.argmin(dd))
    i = int(np.argmax(equity[: j + 1]))
    return {"peak": str(ts[i])[:10], "trough": str(ts[j])[:10],
            "dd": float(-dd[j])}


def subperiod(ts, equity, lo, hi):
    m = ((ts >= pd.Timestamp(lo, tz="America/New_York"))
         & (ts < pd.Timestamp(hi, tz="America/New_York") + pd.Timedelta(days=1)))
    x, tt = equity[m], ts[m]
    if len(x) < 2:
        return None
    years = (tt[-1] - tt[0]).total_seconds() / (365.25 * 86400)
    peak = np.maximum.accumulate(x)
    return {"cagr": float((x[-1] / x[0]) ** (1 / years) - 1),
            "max_drawdown": float(-(x / peak - 1).min()),
            "years": float(years)}


def calendar_year_cut(ts, equity, year: int) -> dict:
    s = pd.Series(equity, index=ts)
    d = s.groupby(ts.date).last()
    r = d.pct_change().dropna()
    r = r[np.array([x.year != year for x in r.index])]
    eq = np.cumprod(1.0 + r.to_numpy())
    years = len(r) / 252.0
    peak = np.maximum.accumulate(eq)
    return {"cagr": float(eq[-1] ** (1 / years) - 1),
            "max_drawdown": float(-(eq / peak - 1).min()),
            "years": float(years)}


def cash_attribution(sig, t, o, c):
    """Fill-to-fill cash periods and the TQQQ return that was avoided."""
    first, last, nd = sig["first"], sig["last"], sig["nd"]
    q = sig["q"]
    tq_open = np.array([o[int(first[i]), COL_T] for i in range(nd)])
    cash = []
    i = 0
    while i < nd:
        if t[i] == 0:
            j = i
            while j + 1 < nd and t[j + 1] == 0:
                j += 1
            if j + 2 < nd:
                tq_ret = tq_open[j + 2] / tq_open[i + 1] - 1.0
            else:
                tq_ret = tq_open[nd - 1] / tq_open[i + 1] - 1.0
            cash.append({
                "exit_signal": str(sig["dates"][first[i]])[:10],
                "reentry_signal": str(sig["dates"][first[j]])[:10],
                "days": int(j - i + 1),
                "qqq_return": float(q[min(j + 1, nd - 1)] / q[i] - 1.0),
                "tqqq_return": float(tq_ret),
                "log_tqqq": float(np.log1p(tq_ret)),
            })
            i = j + 1
        else:
            i += 1
    return cash


def episode_table(sig, eps, ts, o, c):
    """TQQQ next-open return of each round trip."""
    first, last, nd = sig["first"], sig["last"], sig["nd"]

    def next_open(k):
        if k + 1 < nd:
            return float(o[int(first[k + 1]), COL_T])
        return float(c[int(last[k]), COL_T])

    out = []
    for e in eps:
        i, j = int(e["entry_i"]), int(e["exit_i"])
        tq_in = next_open(i)
        tq_out = next_open(j)
        out.append({
            "entry": str(sig["dates"][first[i]])[:10],
            "exit": str(sig["dates"][first[j]])[:10],
            "days": int(e["days"]),
            "entry_why": e.get("entry_why"),
            "exit_why": e.get("exit_why"),
            "entry_dd20": e.get("entry_dd20"),
            "entry_dd60": e.get("entry_dd60"),
            "entry_vr": e.get("entry_vr"),
            "qqq_return": float(e["qret"]),
            "tqqq_return": float(tq_out / tq_in - 1.0),
        })
    return out


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# placebo
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def block_permute(t: np.ndarray, block: int, rng) -> np.ndarray:
    n = len(t)
    starts = list(range(0, n, block))
    blocks = [t[s:s + block] for s in starts]
    order = rng.permutation(len(blocks))
    return np.concatenate([blocks[i] for i in order])[:n]


def random_breaker(t: np.ndarray, rng) -> np.ndarray:
    """Keep the cash/equity labels but put them at random non-overlapping dates."""
    n = len(t)
    # cash runs from the real series
    runs = []
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j + 1 < n and t[j + 1] == t[i]:
            j += 1
        if t[i] == 0:
            runs.append(j - i + 1)
        i = j + 1
    out = np.ones(n)
    total = sum(runs)
    if total == 0:
        return out
    # place the cash runs at random starts; retry to avoid overlap
    for length in runs:
        placed = False
        for _ in range(100):
            s = int(rng.integers(0, max(n - length, 1)))
            if out[s:s + length].all():
                out[s:s + length] = 0.0
                placed = True
                break
        if not placed:
            # fall back to a random contiguous block
            s = int(rng.integers(0, max(n - length, 1)))
            out[s:s + length] = 0.0
    return out


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# main
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def main():
    ts, o, c = load_panel()
    sig = session_signals(ts, c)
    print(f"panel {len(ts):,} bars, {sig['nd']} sessions, "
          f"{sig['dates'][sig['first'][0]]} .. "
          f"{sig['dates'][sig['last'][-1]]}")
    print(f"pre-history {sig['npre']} QQQ closes (2015 only)")

    w, eps, sig, t = build_weights(ts, o, c, return_episodes=True)
    out = {
        "strategy": "drawdown-recovery-v2",
        "directory": "research/new/drawdown-recovery-v2",
        "window": {"start": DEV_START, "end": DEV_END, "marks": "1m",
                   "fills": "next open, 2% band", "idle": "cash at 0%"},
        "rules": {
            "arm_dd20": ARM_20, "arm_dd60": ARM_60,
            "vol_ratio": VOL_RATIO, "vol_window": VOL_WIN,
            "vol_long": VOL_LONG, "hi_window": HI_N,
            "trail": TRAIL, "deep_dd60": DEEP_DD60,
            "deep_rule": "vol contraction only",
            "shallow_rule": "10d high or vol contraction",
            "state": "long by default; cash after a new drawdown",
            "warmup": "QQQ daily closes 2015-01-02..2015-12-31",
        },
        "dev": {},
    }

    results = {}
    for slip in (1.0, 5.0, 10.0):
        res, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, w, slip=slip)
        results[slip] = (res, s)
        out["dev"][f"{int(slip)}bp"] = pack(s)
        print(f"centre {slip:2.0f}bp  CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sharpe {s['sharpe']:4.2f}  "
              f"exp {s['exposure']*100:5.1f}%  fills {s['fills']:,}  "
              f"turnover {s['turnover']:.2f}x")

    res1, s1 = results[1.0]
    i0 = bt.start_index(ts, DEV_START)
    bench = bt.benchmark(c[i0:, COL_T], ts[i0:], BARS_1M)
    out["benchmark_tqqq"] = {k: float(v) for k, v in bench.items()}
    out["benchmark_tqqq"]["symbol"] = "TQQQ"
    out["benchmark_tqqq"]["bar_from_brief"] = {
        "cagr": 0.3672, "max_drawdown": 0.8229, "sharpe": 0.82}
    out["corr_daily_tqqq"] = float(
        daily_returns(res1).corr(
            daily_returns({"equity": c[i0:, COL_T], "ts": ts[i0:]})))

    out["yearly"] = {
        str(k): {"strategy": float(v["strategy"]),
                 "benchmark": float(v["benchmark"])}
        for k, v in bt.yearly(res1["ts"], res1["equity"],
                              c[i0:, COL_T]).items()
    }
    out["dd_window"] = dd_window(res1["ts"], res1["equity"])
    out["subperiods"] = {
        "2016_2019": subperiod(res1["ts"], res1["equity"],
                               "2016-01-04", "2019-12-31"),
        "2020_2021": subperiod(res1["ts"], res1["equity"],
                               "2020-01-02", "2021-12-31"),
        "2022_2023": subperiod(res1["ts"], res1["equity"],
                               "2022-01-03", "2023-12-29"),
    }
    out["exposure_by_year"] = {
        str(y): float(np.mean(
            ((res1["equity"] - res1["cash"]) / res1["equity"])[res1["ts"].year == y]))
        for y in sorted(set(res1["ts"].year))
    }

    # ---- pre-registered grid (8 cells) --------------------------------------
    grid_spec = [
        (0.07, 0.11, 0.60), (0.08, 0.12, 0.60), (0.09, 0.13, 0.60),
        (0.10, 0.15, 0.60), (0.08, 0.12, 0.55), (0.08, 0.12, 0.65),
        (0.07, 0.11, 0.65), (0.09, 0.13, 0.55),
    ]
    grid = []
    ws = []
    for a20, a60, vr in grid_spec:
        ws.append(build_weights(ts, o, c, arm_20=a20, arm_60=a60,
                                vol_ratio=vr))
    for (a20, a60, vr), wt in zip(grid_spec, ws):
        _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)

                     **pack(s)})
        print(f"grid {a20:.0%}/{a60:.0%} vol{vr:.2f}  "

              f"Sh {s['sharpe']:4.2f}  exp {s['exposure']*100:5.1f}%")
    out["grid"] = grid

    # ---- neighbours (robustness, not used to choose the centre) -------------
    neigh_spec = [

        ("trail 10%", {"trail": 0.10}),
        ("shallow vol-only", {"shallow_rule": "vol_only"}),

        ("start in cash", {"start_long": False}),
    ]
    neigh = []
    for name, kw in neigh_spec:
        wt = build_weights(ts, o, c, **kw)
        _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
        neigh.append({"name": name, **pack(s)})
        print(f"neigh {name:20s} CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "

    # ---- ablations ----------------------------------------------------------

        wt = build_weights(ts, o, c, **kw)

        abl.append({"name": name, **pack(s)})
        print(f"ablate {name:34s} CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "

    # ---- controls / attribution --------------------------------------------
    controls = {}
    const = float(np.mean(t))
    w_const = np.zeros((len(ts), 3))
    w_const[:, COL_T] = const
    _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, w_const)
    controls["constant_exposure_same_mean"] = {**pack(s), "weight": const}

    w_bh = np.zeros((len(ts), 3))
    w_bh[:, COL_T] = 1.0
    _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, w_bh)
    controls["tqqq_buy_hold_harness"] = pack(s)

    w_cash = np.zeros((len(ts), 3))
    _, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, w_cash)
    controls["all_cash"] = pack(s)
    out["controls"] = controls
    for k, v in controls.items():
        print(f"control {k:32s} CAGR {v['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {v['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {v['sharpe']:4.2f}")

    # ---- episode table ------------------------------------------------------
    out["episodes"] = episode_table(sig, eps, ts, o, c)
    out["n_round_trips"] = len(out["episodes"])
    out["cash_fraction"] = float(1.0 - np.mean(t))
    out["deep_episodes"] = int(sum(
        1 for e in out["episodes"] if str(e.get("entry_why", "")).startswith("deep")))
    cash = cash_attribution(sig, t, o, c)
    out["cash_periods"] = cash
    out["n_cash_episodes"] = len(cash)
    out["cash_log_tqqq"] = float(sum(x["log_tqqq"] for x in cash))
    out["negative_cash_episodes"] = int(sum(
        1 for x in cash if x["tqqq_return"] < 0))
    out["avg_cash_days"] = float(np.mean([x["days"] for x in cash]))
    out["median_cash_days"] = float(np.median([x["days"] for x in cash]))
    out["strategy_log"] = float(np.log(res1["equity"][-1] / res1["equity"][0]))

    j18 = bt.start_index(ts, "2018-01-29")
    j18e = bt.start_index(ts, "2018-04-26")
    x18 = c[j18:j18e, COL_T]
    out["benchmark_dd_2018_window"] = float(
        -(x18 / np.maximum.accumulate(x18) - 1.0).min())

    # ---- placebo -----------------------------------------------------------
    rng = np.random.default_rng(20261127)
    real = s1["cagr"]
    block_cagrs = []
    for _ in range(80):
        tp = block_permute(t, 20, rng)
        wp = np.zeros((len(ts), 3))
        wp[:, COL_T] = weights_from_daily(sig, tp)
        _, sp = run_weights(ts, o, c, wp)
        block_cagrs.append(sp["cagr"])
    block_cagrs = np.array(block_cagrs)

    random_cagrs = []
    for _ in range(80):
        tp = random_breaker(t, rng)
        wp = np.zeros((len(ts), 3))
        wp[:, COL_T] = weights_from_daily(sig, tp)
        _, sp = run_weights(ts, o, c, wp)
        random_cagrs.append(sp["cagr"])
    random_cagrs = np.array(random_cagrs)

    out["placebo"] = {
        "real_cagr": float(real),
        "block_permutation_20d": {
            "n_draws": int(len(block_cagrs)),
            "mean": float(block_cagrs.mean()),
            "p95": float(np.percentile(block_cagrs, 95)),
            "p_value": float((block_cagrs >= real).mean()),
        },
        "random_circuit_breaker": {
            "n_draws": int(len(random_cagrs)),
            "mean": float(random_cagrs.mean()),
            "p95": float(np.percentile(random_cagrs, 95)),
            "p_value": float((random_cagrs >= real).mean()),
        },
    }
    print("placebo", {k: (v if not isinstance(v, dict) else
                         {kk: round(float(vv), 4) for kk, vv in v.items()})
                     for k, v in out["placebo"].items()})

    # ---- cut tests ---------------------------------------------------------
    cuts = {}
    for year in (2018, 2020, 2022, 2023):
        cuts[str(year)] = {
            "strategy": calendar_year_cut(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], year),
            "benchmark_ex_year": calendar_year_cut(ts[i0:], c[i0:, COL_T], year),
        }
    out["cut_tests"] = cuts
    for y, v in cuts.items():
        print(f"cut ex-{y}: strat {v['strategy']['cagr']*100:6.2f}% / "
              f"{v['strategy']['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  "
              f"bench {v['benchmark_ex_year']['cagr']*100:6.2f}% / "
              f"{v['benchmark_ex_year']['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%")

    # ---- causality: truncation at 2022-01-03 -------------------------------
    j = bt.start_index(ts, "2022-01-03")
    j0 = int(sig["first"][np.searchsorted(sig["first"], j)])
    w_trunc = build_weights(ts[:j0], o[:j0], c[:j0])
    out["causality"] = {
        "truncation_date": "2022-01-03",
        "prior_weights_unchanged": bool(np.allclose(w_trunc[:-1], w[:j0 - 1])),
    }
    print("causality", out["causality"])

    (HERE / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2, default=float))
    print("wrote", HERE / "result.json")
